note: Room verbs with data-defined effects. References are validated at boot by runtime/actions.mjs; effects are applied by the reducer, so a recorded action replays.

effects.text: The pool clears. A stair of water descends into the dark.

messages.actor: You turn the mirror toward the pool. The water clears.
messages.others: %a turns the mirror toward the pool; the water clears.

effects.text: The statue grinds aside. The ward chest opens.

messages.actor: You push the statue aside. The ward chest opens.
messages.others: %a pushes the statue aside. The ward chest opens.

effects.text: The bell rings without a clapper. Somewhere below, a door answers.

messages.actor: You ring the bell. It has no clapper, but the room answers.
messages.others: %a rings the bell. The room answers.

effects.text: The eye-shaped keyhole closes. A stair of black stone descends.

messages.actor: You turn the ward key. The Deep Door opens downward.
messages.others: %a turns a key in the Deep Door; it opens downward.

effects.text: The blank brow belongs to the room itself. The name is not written yet.

messages.actor: You read the names. One brow is blank.
messages.others: %a studies the names on the skulls.

effects.text: The shrine is quiet. Some of the cold leaves you.

messages.actor: You kneel at the shrine and feel a little warmer.

effects.text: The wardstone is warm. Something inside it turns over and settles.

messages.actor: You touch the wardstone. It beats once under your hand.
messages.others: %a touches the wardstone; it beats once.

effects.text: The hair binding the chest parts. The reliquary opens.
The last lantern burns brighter for a moment. The quiet door is listening.

messages.actor: You fill the last lantern. The flame steadies.

effects.text: The pale wood warms and the seam widens into a door.

messages.actor: You touch the quiet door. The lantern answers, and the seam widens.
messages.others: %a touches the quiet door; a seam of light widens.

effects.text: Warm air rushes over you and the ache in your bones fades.

messages.actor: You pump the bellows. Warm air rushes over you.
messages.others: %a pumps the bellows; warm air fills the room.

effects.text: The iron band loosens and the chest opens.

messages.actor: You fit the ash key to the chest. The band loosens.

effects.text: The first flame folds around you and sets you down at the ashen threshold.

messages.actor: You step into the first flame. Heat folds around you and the chamber is gone.
messages.others: %a steps into the first flame and vanishes.

effects.text: The green iron band loosens and the chest opens.

messages.actor: You fit the green key to the chest. The band loosens.

effects.text: The root folds around you and sets you down at the fen gate.

messages.actor: You step into the green heart. The root folds around you and the chamber is gone.
messages.others: %a steps into the green heart and vanishes.

effects.text: The salt band cracks and the chest opens.

messages.actor: You fit the brine key to the chest. The salt band cracks.

effects.text: The salt pillar folds around you and sets you down at the stair.

messages.actor: You step into the salt heart. The cave folds and the stair is beneath you.
messages.others: %a steps into the salt heart and vanishes.

effects.text: The silver cord loosens and the pale chest opens.

messages.actor: You fit the moon key to the pale chest. The cord loosens.

effects.text: The crescent moon folds around you and sets you down at the gate.

messages.actor: You step into the crescent moon. The glade folds and the gate is beneath you.
messages.others: %a steps into the moon and vanishes.
